gpu_type: NVIDIA GB200 NVL4 (2x Grace CPU + 4x B200 GPU per node)
notes: There is a single GPU partition. Request a total GPU count with --gpus=N; do not use --gpus-per-node or --gres.
Only these GPU counts are accepted: 1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 12, 16. Slurm derives node_count automatically (4 GPUs/node); do not set --nodes unless overriding that default.
Each GPU brings a fixed share of the node: 36 CPU cores and ~400GB of combined CPU+GPU memory.
Max wall time is 96 hours regardless of GPU count.
Compute node scratch is /tmp (xfs, local, 1.5TB per requested GPU), deleted automatically when the job ends.
Slurm commands require a login shell environment.
Compute nodes are aarch64 — binaries and Python wheels built for x86_64 will not run.

modules.nvhpc: Standard NVIDIA HPC SDK environment including MPI
modules.nvhpc-nompi: NVIDIA HPC SDK without MPI; use when you prepare and use another MPI yourself
modules.nvhpc-hpcx: nvhpc combined with HPC-X; use for HPC-X MPI in an InfiniBand/RDMA environment
modules.nvhpc-hpcx-cuda13: Same as nvhpc-hpcx but with the CUDA version fixed to CUDA 13
modules.nvhpc-byo-compiler: Use a compiler you prepare yourself, such as the system GCC ('Bring Your Own')

spack.commands: spack find -x (list provided software); spack load <package>; spack unload <package>; spack info <package>
spack.private_instance_note: Users may build a private Spack instance under $HOME and chain it to the public instance via upstreams.yaml to reuse prebuilt dependencies.

scratch.access: owner only, node-local, deleted at job end
